title: Experience the best of Sydney as an international student at UTS
description:
At the University of Technology Sydney (UTS), your journey goes beyond the classroom. Study in the heart of one of the world’s best student cities, surrounded by culture, opportunity, and a welcoming community. At UTS, you’ll find a place where you can belong, grow, and thrive in Sydney.

Find out more at: https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/new-students/international-students/kick-start-your-dream-career-today

About the University of Technology Sydney   
The University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the leading technology university in Australia, and amongst the top 100 universities in the world. Through its future-focused approach to learning and research, UTS prepares students for the challenges of today and tomorrow. Located in Sydney’s technology precinct, UTS is minutes away from the city’s business district and some of Australia’s most innovative companies and startups.

UTS TEQSA No: PRV12060

title: NYU's 2022 Commencement Speaker Taylor Swift
description:
New York University Holds 188th Commencement at Yankee Stadium, May 18, 2022

Singer, songwriter, producer, and director Taylor Swift received a Doctor of Fine Arts, honoris causa, at the Commencement for the Class of 2022 and delivered remarks on behalf of the honorary degree recipients.

title: NerdyAndQuirky's 5 tips for surviving your first year at U of T
description:

title: 只說「我不懂」？把問題問具體｜LTU OSSD #Shorts
description:
卡住時，只說「我不懂」嗎？
把問題說具體，讓下一步更清楚。

① 說出自己已做到哪一步
② 指出不理解的地方
③ 問下一步可以怎麼想

得到提示後，再用自己的話整理一次。這是可自行練習的學習方法；實際課程及支援安排需個別確認。

私訊「OSSD＋目前年級」，了解雙聯學習規劃。
https://www.ossdtw.com/

AI生成情境示意，非學生見證。
